description: This file defines Data Access Objects (DAOs) for a calendar and astrology application. It contains interface definitions for database operations related to calendar events, leaves, and astrology details, including querying, inserting, updating, and deleting records.

methods.name: getEventsForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events occurring within a specified start and end time.

methods.name: getEventsForDate
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events for a specific date.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertEvent
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a calendar event in the database.

methods.name: deleteEventById
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event based on its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves leave entries within a specified date range.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leave entries modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertLeave
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a leave record.

methods.name: deleteLeaveById
methods.description: Deletes a leave record by ID.

methods.name: getAstrologyForDate
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves astrology records modified after a timestamp.

methods.name: insertAstrology
methods.description: Inserts or replaces an astrology record.
